verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a genuine llms.txt (HTTP 200) on the www origin that an agent can be pointed at. A public, keyless OpenAPI document also gives agents machine-readable API docs. However, the llms.txt only lists marketing surfaces (registered agent, annual report, software) with one-line descriptions, and the developer portal is a JS-rendered shell. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt covering the developer/API docs, markdown or agent-readable versions of the developer portal pages, and independent corroboration of agent use.
